_: 手写的注解，盖在 Localization.swift 解析结果之上。scripts/build-copy-editor.py 会合并它。

allRoomsOn.note: Sits under the friend-activity switch as a summary of the room list one level down, so you can tell at a glance whether anything is muted.

eveningOneDayReminder.note: 英文里有单复数判断（1 段 / 2 段），所以这一栏锁住了 —— 想改英文跟我说，我在代码里改。
eveningOneDayReminder.en: \(remaining) moment\(remaining == 1 ? "" : "s") left today. Save one for now.

momentWord.note: The word "moment", agreeing with a count. English needs this and Chinese doesn't, which is exactly how "Preview · 1 moments" got shipped: every caller wrote the

headerDateProgress.note: Home header progress, beside the date: "今天 1/7".

deleteStoryTitle.note: Deleting a story and leaving a room are one menu item but two very different outcomes, and the difference is exactly what someone needs to know before they tap.

deleteStoryWarning.note: 英文里有单复数判断（1 段 / 2 段），所以这一栏锁住了 —— 想改英文跟我说，我在代码里改。
deleteStoryWarning.en: The \(clipCount) clip\(clipCount == 1 ? "" : "s") you filmed will be deleted too. This can’t be undone.

deleteStoryWarningEmpty.note: 同一句的另一支：一段都没拍的时候显示这句（测试要求它不能出现数字）。

joinShort.note: On the header pill next to 新建, so the icon isn't the only clue.

joinRoomButton.note: Not "today's room": a room can be a seven-day story, and the button said otherwise on every one of them.

orientationName.note: The frame a clip was filmed in, named the way the picker names it — so "no landscape plan yet" and the row that would have created one agree.  Taken as the orie

keepClipFootnote.note: Names where "keep" puts it. Without this the two buttons are a coin toss — nobody should have to guess whether "保留" means it goes somewhere findable or just sta

storyIsFull.note: Every slot in that story already holds a clip. Filing here would have to overwrite one, so it doesn't.

noPlaceForDraft.note: No matching story for this clip's frame, from inside the drafts list — where "retake" isn't an option, so it says what would help instead.

draftSize.note: Rounded file size, so someone can see which drafts are worth deleting.

cameraDeniedTitle.note: Said separately from "camera not available", because the way out is different: iOS won't ask a second time, so retrying here can never work.

momentPosition.note: Spoken by the progress bars over the camera. There is no visible version of this — the bars themselves say it, and they only appear when the numbers in them are

rerecordShort.note: The same action as `rerecord`, for a chip sitting on top of the video where "Re-record this day" wraps to two lines and stops being a chip.

thisMoment.note: The review screen's card of things you can do to one moment, and the button that gives the clip the whole display when you want it.

meTitle.note: The settings screen, which leads with who you are rather than with a list of switches.

statFinished.note: Stories with every moment filmed. Deliberately not "films exported" — nothing tracks exports, and a number the app can't actually count is worse than one it can

captionAction.note: The chip that opens the caption editor. `addCaption` is the placeholder *inside* the editor, which is a sentence; this is a button, which isn't.

lookTitle.note: Never "美颜" and never "beauty". Both words presume something is wrong with the face in the picture; the phone's camera is what was unkind.

lookFootnote.note: The promise, said out loud on the screen where it matters: the file is never touched, so this is always undoable.

lookExposure.note: The three dials. Named for what the camera got wrong, not for the Core Image filter underneath — nobody films thinking "my white point is off".

lookReset.note: Puts all three dials back to centre.

greeting.note: Time-of-day greeting. The name is optional — a solo user never signs in.

resumeStory.note: Used instead of `todaysStory` when nothing was started today but something is still unfinished — saying "today's story" then would be a lie about what the card

yourStories.note: Heads the reverse-chronological list below today's story. Replaces the old "your other plans" / "finished films" split, which sorted by state and so couldn't an

momentsShort.note: Chip-length moment count. `momentCount` is a full sentence and blows a capsule out to four lines.

templateRuntime.note: "2s each" — the per-clip length on a template card.

openMomentLabel.note: One open moment, named on the home card so the story has a face on it.  It says "还没拍" rather than "接下来" on purpose: the button beside it opens this moment becau

pickOneCreatesIt.note: The one-screen composer: the poster *is* the submit button, so the label above the grid has to say so — there is no 下一步 left to imply it.

captionGestureHint.note: Shown under a caption the first time it is selected, then never again. Three gestures, in the order people reach for them.

deleteCaptionAction.note: The ✕ on the selected caption's box, and the corner opposite it. Both are icon-only on screen, so these exist for VoiceOver and for the tests.

captionPlateSample.note: What the four backing samples say. One character in Chinese, two letters in English — enough to show the colour on the backing, short enough that four samples f

captionPlateName.note: The samples are pictures, so these exist for VoiceOver and the tests.

captionEditAction.note: On the button once a caption exists: it edits rather than adds.

chatShort.note: Beside two other buttons on one row, so it is the short form.

avatarColourN.note: The seven dots under your avatar are colours, and a colour has no name worth saying out loud — numbered so VoiceOver can count them.

catchUpDayLabel.note: On the home card when the button opens a day that isn't today, because today's is already filmed and an earlier one is missing.

openSystemSettings.note: Next to the "needs photo access" line, so the dead end has a door.

coverFromClips.note: First of the three sources, because a frame out of the day is the most honest cover a story can have.

useThisFrame.note: Confirms the lifted frame. The frame is on screen above it, so the word is 这张 and not "保存".

coverKeepFilming.note: Back to the automatic cover — newest clip, then the poster. Named after what it does next, not after "reset".

nextReminderAt.note: Under the evening reminder switch: when it will actually go off.

reminderNothingToNudge.note: Nothing unfilmed means nothing to nudge about — true, and worth saying, because it is otherwise identical to a broken switch.

followPrompts.note: The two halves of the one pill selector at the top of the screen. They filter what's below; they are not themselves a thing you "pick", which is why they're pil

rackByTime.note: The same two choices as `followPrompts` / `recordByTime`, shortened to share one row with 一日 and 七日. Four segments in a Chinese pill leave about three character

storySettingsTitle.note: The settings sheet behind a poster's gear, and the button that closes it by creating the story.

noCustomTemplatesYet.note: The empty 自己写 rack: no saved prompt sets yet.

customPromptsLead.note: On the entry card at the top of the composer, where it has to say what the screen behind it actually does — that one is 说说今天要干嘛 with a sentence in and prompts o

roomExplainer.note: Shown before the room exists, so it has to say the room is empty. The composer used to show faces here instead, which read as "these people are already in" — no

yourTakes.note: Beside the room's own count, so "3/5" can mean the day and this can mean me. Only shown when the two differ.

theMoments.note: Carries the number, because it used to be hard-coded to seven and a three-moment story read "七个瞬间" over a list of three — a factual error the reader can see, on

guidedFootnote.note: Says what "就用这些" is still waiting for. A grey button whose reason lives off-screen is a dead end, and the name field scrolls away first.

storyNameNeeded.note: Shown on the name card itself, where the fix is.

suggestFailed.note: Not an error dialog: the thing they were doing still works, and the list is right there. This only explains why nothing appeared.

clipLengthRow.note: Row labels. `clipLengthHeader` / `orientationHeader` are the older all-caps section headers and wrap awkwardly inside an `OptionRow`.

displayAndLanguage.note: One heading over the three "what the app looks and reads like" rows. Each is a choice you make once, so they get one line apiece and the options live one screen

momentsFilmed.note: The story page: how far the day has got, and the words on the list of moments that are still yours to take.

watchTheFilm.note: The way into the film, on the one card the page allows itself — and only once there's nothing left to film.

startHere.note: The one row that's a suggestion. A question, because that's all it is — every other row does exactly the same thing when you tap it.

addYourTake.note: A moment a friend already filmed. The thumbnail plays their take; this row is how mine gets in.

peopleInRoom.note: The roster's caption. A room of one is worth saying out loud — an invite code nobody used looks exactly like a room full of friends until somebody counts the fa

roomWhoFilmed.note: Whether anyone else showed up. Four sentences rather than a count, because "2 filmed" answers none of the four things a room is actually being asked: who's here

roomWaitingOn.note: Who the room is waiting on. One line about people, never a row per moment: which moment they film is theirs to pick.

defaultMemberName.note: Apple only hands over a name on the very first sign-in. Without one, somebody has to be called something in a room full of friends.

signIn.note: The way back in. Until this existed, signing out was one-way from here: the only other sign-in gate is the one guarding a shared story.

deleteAccountFailedTitle.note: Said out loud, because the alternative — a spinner that ends and a screen that looks finished — is the app claiming something it can't check. Naming what is sti

deletedMemberName.note: Replaces a departed creator's name on a room their friends still use.
